biggest_catch: The offer EXPIRES September 30, 2026 — about 7 days from verification — and online opening is available to sole proprietors only (you must own and control 100% of the business); multi-owner businesses must open in a branch. The entry $300 tier still requires parking an average ledger balance of $5,000 through your entire third full month after opening.
catches: Offer good through September 30, 2026 — the window closes in days; open before that date.
Online account opening is available for sole proprietors only (one owner, no partners, must own and control 100%). Other business structures must visit a local M&T branch.

Tiered by AVERAGE ledger balance in the third full month after opening: $300 for $5,000–$14,999.99; $500 for $15,000–$29,999.99; $750 for $30,000–$99,999.99; $1,500 for $100,000+. This is parked cash with a real opportunity cost.
Use promo code BO at account opening (it auto-applies online); in-branch openers should email themselves the bonus coupon from the page.
Monthly maintenance fees apply: $5 (Business Essential), $15 (Business Plus), $25 (Business Premium) — waivable with qualifying activity/balances; unwaived fees eat into the bonus.
Bonus is credited by the end of the fourth month after opening — not immediate.
The separate 'up to $500 more with Merchant Services' stack is a different mechanism (requires opening an M&T Merchant Services account and processing volume) and is NOT part of this route.
Like other bank bonuses, expect the bonus to be reported as taxable interest income (confirm at tax time).

steps: If you are a sole proprietor (100% owner), open a new M&T Business Checking account online by September 30, 2026 — promo code BO applies automatically; multi-owner businesses must visit a local M&T branch (email yourself the bonus coupon from the page first).
Fund the account and maintain the tier's average ledger balance through your entire third full month after opening ($5,000+ for $300; $15,000+ for $500; $30,000+ for $750; $100,000+ for $1,500).
Meet a monthly-fee waiver condition (balance or activity) each month so fees don't erode the bonus.
The bonus is credited to the account by the end of the fourth month.
